# Zoho Analytics REST API v2 - OKF bundle

> Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) bundle for the Zoho Analytics REST API v2: 182 endpoints across 10 domains, with the conventions, OAuth scopes, roles, identifiers and 306 error codes they share. Base URL https://analyticsapi.zoho.com, path prefix /restapi/v2, OAuth 2.0 with the Zoho-oauthtoken scheme, structured input in a single JSON parameter named CONFIG.

Read overview.md first, then how-to-use-this-bundle.md for the frontmatter contract and navigation rules. Links inside the bundle are relative to the document that contains them; resolve them against that document's URL under https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0. Paths beginning with a slash appear only in frontmatter (resource, sources, api.openapi.file) and are relative to the bundle root, which is https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0. This bundle covers API version v2 (v2.0); the repository manifest at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sathishkumar-ks-8646/analytics-api/main/manifest.json names every available version and the artefacts built for each.

## Start here

- [Zoho Analytics REST API v2 - overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/overview.md): What the Zoho Analytics REST API v2 is, how it is organized into 10 domains and 168 endpoints, and the five conventions every call shares.
- [How to use this bundle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/how-to-use-this-bundle.md): Structure of the Zoho Analytics REST API v2 OKF bundle, the frontmatter contract of each concept type, and navigation rules for AI assistants, SDK generators, Postman runners and MCP servers.
- [Endpoint catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/endpoint-catalog.md): All 182 Zoho Analytics REST API v2 endpoints in one table: method, path, operation ID, group, OAuth scope, success status and organization-header requirement.
- [Bundle index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/index.md): the full table of contents.

## Foundations (rules shared by every call)

- [Asynchronous jobs (export and import)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/asynchronous-jobs.md): How background jobs work in Zoho Analytics REST API v2 - job creation, jobCode states, polling, callbackUrl notifications, batch import keys, retention and ownership rules.
- [Authentication (OAuth 2.0)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/authentication.md): How to authenticate Zoho Analytics REST API v2 calls with OAuth 2.0 access tokens, the Authorization header format, token lifetime and refresh, and the errors returned when authentication fails.
- [Custom roles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/custom-roles.md): Organization-defined custom roles in Zoho Analytics - the three access permission levels, the full permission catalogue by category, how a custom role name is used by the REST API v2 user-management endpoints, and how its permissions map onto the API's authorization vocabulary.
- [Data centers and base URLs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/data-centers.md): The Zoho Analytics API host (ZohoAnalytics_Server_URI) and OAuth accounts host for each data center, and the rules for choosing them.
- [Error codes - quick reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/error-codes-quick-reference.md): Compact one-line-per-code table of all 306 Zoho Analytics REST API v2 error codes (code, summary constant, HTTP status, meaning); use the full catalog for per-operation reasons and solutions.
- [Error code catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/error-codes.md): Every documented Zoho Analytics REST API v2 error code (306 codes) with its meaning, typical HTTP status, resolution and the operations that raise it.
- [Export formats and enumerations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/export-formats-and-enums.md): Every enumerated CONFIG attribute shared by the Zoho Analytics REST API v2 export endpoints and email schedules - responseFormat, CSV delimiters, PDF page setup, header and footer slots, image options, email exportType - with default values and error codes.
- [Filter criteria syntax](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/filter-criteria-syntax.md): Grammar and rules of the SQL-like criteria expression used by Zoho Analytics REST API v2 to filter rows in exports, row updates and deletes, shares, embed URLs, publish configurations and email schedules.
- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/glossary.md): Definitions of every Zoho Analytics object and term used across the REST API v2 documentation - organization, workspace, view, table, query table, report, dashboard, column, lookup, formula, variable, datasource, job, share, publish, embed, slideshow, schedule, AutoML, portal and more.
- [HTTP status codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/http-status-codes.md): Which HTTP status codes Zoho Analytics REST API v2 returns, what each one means, and how it maps to the application error codes in the failure envelope.
- [Identifiers and how to obtain them](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/identifiers.md): Every identifier used in Zoho Analytics REST API v2 paths and headers (organization, workspace, view, column, job, schedule and more), its format, and the operations that return it.
- [Import options and enumerations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/import-options-and-enums.md): The CONFIG vocabulary shared by the Zoho Analytics REST API v2 import endpoints - importType modes, fileType, autoIdentify, onError, number separators, columnDataTypes, matchingColumns, payload limits, and the permission each mode needs.
- [OAuth scopes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/oauth-scopes.md): All Zoho Analytics OAuth 2.0 scopes, what each family covers, and which REST API v2 operations require each scope.
- [Permission matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/permission-matrix.md): For every Zoho Analytics REST API v2 operation: the OAuth scope, whether the organization header is needed, and the role or view permission the caller must hold.
- [Rate limits, throttling and quotas](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/rate-limits-and-quotas.md): Per-operation request throttles, concurrency guards, plan-governed quotas and API unit consumption for the Zoho Analytics REST API v2.
- [Report and dashboard enumerations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/report-and-dashboard-enums.md): Every enumerated CONFIG value shared by the Zoho Analytics REST API v2 report and dashboard endpoints - chart types, axis types and which report type accepts them, aggregate operations and the column data types they apply to, filter types, dashboard card types and the layout grid rules.
- [Request conventions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/request-conventions.md): The rules shared by every Zoho Analytics REST API v2 request - URL structure, path placeholders, mandatory headers, the CONFIG parameter and how to encode it per HTTP method, multipart uploads, and idempotency.
- [Response envelope](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/response-envelope.md): The JSON envelope returned by Zoho Analytics REST API v2 on success and failure, the 204 no-body pattern, file responses from export endpoints, and the value conventions inside data.
- [Roles and permissions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/roles-and-permissions.md): The authorization model of Zoho Analytics REST API v2 - organization roles, workspace roles, view-level share permissions, ownership, and how the "Permission Required" statements in endpoint documents should be read.
- [SDK clients and code samples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/sdk-clients.md): The official Zoho Analytics client libraries (Java, C#, Go, PHP, Python, Node.js, Ruby), the Deluge scripting pattern, how each client is constructed from OAuth credentials, and how to read the per-endpoint SDK example documents.
- [White Label and Client Portal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/white-label-client-portal.md): How Zoho Analytics White Label (Client Portal) custom domains interact with the REST API v2 - portal request hosts, the domainName attribute, workspace domain access, and which API families are allowed or blocked in a portal context.

## API domains

- [Organization Management](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/domains/organization-management/overview.md): APIs that return information about the organisations, resource usage, subscription plan, and workspace or view identity lookups available to the authenticated user.
- [Users & Groups](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/domains/users-and-groups/overview.md): API for managing users and groups in Zoho Analytics — covering org-level users, workspace-level users, and workspace groups.
- [Workspace Management](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/domains/workspace-management/overview.md): API for managing workspaces in Zoho Analytics — covering workspace operations, preferences, domain access, and folder management.
- [Data Modeling & Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/domains/data-modeling-and-schema/overview.md): API for Data Modeling & Schema in Zoho Analytics — covering tables, schema, columns, lookups, query tables, formulas, and workspace variables.
- [Data Operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/domains/data-operations/overview.md): API for Data Operations in Zoho Analytics — covering row operations, import/export workflows, and datasource sync/connectivity.
- [Views Management](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/domains/views-management/overview.md): API for Views Management in Zoho Analytics — covering view operations, auto analysis, favorites, and trash management.
- [Reports & Dashboards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/domains/reports-and-dashboards/overview.md): API for Reports and Dashboards in Zoho Analytics - covering the creation, update and metadata retrieval of analysis views, and the listing, creation, metadata retrieval and update of dashboards.
- [Share & Publish](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/domains/share-and-publish/overview.md): API for Share & Publish in Zoho Analytics — covering view sharing, publish configurations, embed URLs, and slideshow management.
- [Schedules & Alerts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/domains/schedules-and-alerts/overview.md): API for Schedules & Alerts in Zoho Analytics — covering creation, management, and triggering of email schedules.
- [Data Science & Machine Learning (AutoML)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/domains/dsml/overview.md): API for DSML (Data Science & Machine Learning) in Zoho Analytics — covering AutoML analysis creation, execution, deployments, and what-if analysis.

## Workflows

- [Workflow playbooks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/workflows/index.md): 8 step-by-step procedures spanning several endpoints.
- [Bootstrap: from access token to workspace and view IDs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/workflows/bootstrap-identifiers.md): The first three calls of every integration - list organizations, pick the org ID for the header, and resolve workspace and view names into the IDs that all other endpoints need.
- [Embed a view for many tenants with per-tenant row filters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/workflows/embed-view-multi-tenant.md): Mint one short-lived embed URL per end customer, each carrying its own criteria, permissions and column restrictions, then audit and revoke URLs.
- [Export a view, dashboard or SQL result asynchronously](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/workflows/export-data-asynchronously.md): Create an export job, poll or receive a callback, and download the file - the path for dashboards, query tables, large tables and ad-hoc SQL that the synchronous export rejects.
- [Load data into a table (small, large and very large files)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/workflows/import-large-dataset.md): Choose between synchronous import, asynchronous import job and batch import, then create or fill a table and verify the result.
- [Add users to an organization and a workspace, and set their roles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/workflows/manage-users-and-roles.md): Invite users to the organization, place them in a workspace with a role, promote or demote admins, deactivate leavers, and understand who may perform each step.
- [Schedule a recurring email delivery of a report or dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/workflows/schedule-email-report.md): Create an email schedule with recipients and calendar frequency, trigger it once to test, enable or disable it, and update it safely.
- [Share views with users or groups, with row and column restrictions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/workflows/share-view-with-row-filter.md): Grant a permission set on one or more views to users or a group, optionally limiting rows with criteria and columns with column lists, then inspect, update or revoke the share.
- [Train an AutoML model, deploy it and score a table](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/workflows/train-and-run-automl-model.md): The end-to-end AutoML sequence - create an analysis on a training table, wait for models to train, deploy the best model, run predictions into an output table, and clean up.

## Machine-readable

- [manifest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/manifest.json): bundle version, OKF version, counts, entry points.
- [endpoint-catalog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/references/endpoint-catalog.json): every endpoint with method, path, scopes, permission, error codes and document paths.
- [OpenAPI specifications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/references/openapi/): OpenAPI 3 files, one per domain plus shared components.

## Optional

- [SDK examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/sdk-examples/index.md): per-endpoint code samples (180 documents) in cURL, C#, Go, Java, PHP, Python, Node.js, Ruby and Deluge.
- [SDK clients](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/foundations/sdk-clients.md): The official Zoho Analytics client libraries (Java, C#, Go, PHP, Python, Node.js, Ruby), the Deluge scripting pattern, how each client is constructed from OAuth credentials, and how to read the per-endpoint SDK example documents.
- [Update log](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoho/analytics-okf/main/v2.0/log.md): the OKF log for this bundle.
